subject: executor,tablecodec: optimize decodeIndexKeyValue function for memIndexReader (#56006)
summary: Adds allocation-reduction paths by reusing per-reader buffers in `memIndexReader.decodeIndexKeyValue` and introducing `tablecodec.DecodeIndexKVEx`/`CutIndexKeyTo`/`reEncodeHandleTo`. Reviewed `UnionScanExec`/`memRowsIterForIndex` usage to ensure returned row slices are not overwritten while still referenced (cursor caching prevents concurrent reuse). No Blocker/High correctness, semantics, consistency, or concurrency issues found for the touched executor/tablecodec behavior in this commit vs first parent; no later upstream/master fix appears to be required for this change.
